_doc: Per sim anim name (state or move id): a purchased/imported clip overrides the hand-keyed PoseLib pose or UAL clip. clip = name in assets/anims/ext.res; mode = loop | hold | move (clip spans the move) ; rate = playback multiplier; pose = optional PoseLib key whose rotations are layered on top. mode stride = ground-speed-scaled loop (mps = the clip's planted-foot speed on our rig, from tools/bake_mco.gd; reverse = play backwards; fast_clip above fast_above m/s swaps in the run clip).
